adhocDisabled: Ad-hoc roles are disabled (set DYNAMIC_ROLES=true to enable).
adhocEmptyName: Every ad-hoc role name must contain at least one alphanumeric character.
synthFailed: The council ran, but its final synthesis ({synth}) produced no answer — the text above is the raw discussion, not a finished result. Check structuredContent.turns for the failing turn; a reasoning model that emits no text has usually spent its whole budget thinking, so raise maxTokens — or, if the preset caps that role, the role's own maxTokens — or that model's reasoningAllotment.
roleNotInPreset: Selector "{selector}" uses a role not in preset "{preset}" (allowed: {available}).
presetRoleUnderStaffed: Preset "{preset}" role "{role}" needs at least {min} speaker(s), got {count} — add a selector like "model:{role}".
presetRoleOverStaffed: Preset "{preset}" role "{role}" allows at most {max} speaker(s), got {count} — remove a "model:{role}" selector.
presetRoleMissingFile: Preset "{preset}" references role "{role}" which has no config/roles/{role}.md file.
presetSynthUncovered: Preset "{preset}" synthesizes with role "{role}" — add a selector like "model:{role}" to staff it.
closingWithoutSynth: Closing statements require a synthesizer — set "synthesize" (or use a preset with a synthesizer).
eliminateWithoutSynth: Elimination rounds require an eliminator — staff the preset's eliminator role.
synthTeamed: Neutral officials (synthesizer, eliminator) cannot carry a team tag — drop the "@team" from that selector.
frameTeamed: The framer is a neutral chair and cannot carry a team tag — drop the "@team" from the frame selector.
cancelled: The council was cancelled before it finished — the text above is whatever completed, not a finished result. No synthesis was run.
budgetExhausted: INCOMPLETE — tokenBudget {limit} ran out ({used} tokens used) and {skipped} planned turns were skipped ({seats}), so the verdict above is missing their input. Every turn re-sends the growing transcript, so input dominates spend. Call this tool again right away with the same arguments and tokenBudget of at least {suggested} (or lower maxTokens / rounds / speakers).
jobsBusy: The server is already running {active} of {max} councils. Poll an existing job or try again shortly.
jobHandle: Council {state} as job {jobId} ({phase}). Call `poll` with this jobId every ~{seconds}s until state is completed, failed or cancelled; call `cancel` to stop it. Do not start another council for the same question.
jobNotFound: No job {jobId} is available to you. It may have expired, belong to another caller, or live on a different server instance.
